title: kvfold: folding discarded entries back into a compressed KV cache (code, statistics scripts and per-item records)
description: Training-free wrapper for any kvpress press that folds each discarded KV-cache entry into the kept entry with the most similar key. Contains the wrapper (pip-installable on top of kvpress), the runners and statistics scripts, and the per-item records (ids, arm, score, predicted answer) that rebuild Table 1 of the preprint on a CPU. Benchmark contexts and the RestoreKV checkpoints are not included.
